versions.content: If CanIf_SetPduMode(ControllerId, CANIF_TX_OF- FLINE) is called and Partial Networking is enabled (ref. to CanIfPublicPnSup- port ) the PnTxFilter of the corresponding CAN Controller shall be enabled (ref. to [SWS_CANIF_00748] and [SWS_CANIF_00747]).

If CanIf_SetPduMode(ControllerId, CANIF_TX_OF- FLINE) is called and Partial Networking is enabled (ref. to CanIfPublicPnSup- port ) the PnTxFilter of the corresponding CAN Controller shall be enabled (ref. to [SWS_CANIF_00748] and [SWS_CANIF_00747]).

If CanIf_SetPduMode(ControllerId, CANIF_TX_OF- FLINE) is called and Partial Networking is enabled (ref. to CanIfPublicPnSup- port ) the PnTxFilter of the corresponding CAN Controller shall be enabled (ref. to [SWS_CANIF_00748] and [SWS_CANIF_00747]).

If CanIf_SetPduMode(ControllerId, CANIF_TX_OF- FLINE) is called and Partial Networking is enabled (ref. to CanIfPublicPnSup- port ) the PnTxFilter of the corresponding CAN Controller shall be enabled (ref. to [SWS_CANIF_00748] and [SWS_CANIF_00747]).
